limitations: The theorem counts only primitive period-two orbits, not longer rowmotion orbits.
The general statement requires a connected finite simple graph with at least one edge; the wheel statement requires at least three rim vertices.
Finite verification is not the proof of the infinite formulas.
Equivalence with a prior unindexed edge-cover or rowmotion orbit census remains a scholarly-priority risk.
